scenes.caption: You tap to pay. ₹10 for chai. Done in one second.
But where did that payment actually go?
Not into the sky. Into a data centre.
A building full of servers, running 24×7, storing and processing your digital life.
Your reels. Your cricket streams. Even your AI chats.
In September 2026 alone, India made over 24 billion UPI payments.
Data centres already use about 1.5% of the world's electricity.
India is building more of them, fast.
The good news? Over half of India's installed power capacity is now non-fossil.
Power the cloud with clean energy, and India's digital boom can be a green one.

sources: NPCI: UPI monthly statistics, September 2026 (24.07 bn transactions)
IEA: Energy and AI (2025), data centres ≈1.5% of global electricity in 2024
MNRE: non-fossil installed capacity 300.5 GW (>54%) as of 31 July 2026
